title: helianthemum pilosum subsp. violaceum
intro: Helianthemum pilosum subsp. violaceum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum pilosum subsp. violaceum include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
